purpose: Fixed NORMALFALL development/hold-out assignment for prose-rule calibration. IDs refer to normalfall_beispiele.md and normalfall_kontrollbeispiele.md.

split_policy.principle: group-aware by pattern family, source pass and chapter where possible
split_policy.target_ratio: approximately 75/25 only when sample size supports it
split_policy.small_sample_rule: No category with fewer than 8 relevant examples may receive evidence_status=strong from this corpus alone. If a meaningful hold-out would contain fewer than 2 positive or 2 control examples, quantitative performance is reported as descriptive only.

forbidden_sondern.note: Deterministic project rule. Hold-out checks implementation recall only; no negative corpus exists because final NORMALFALL intentionally contains zero 'sondern'.

softener_density.note: Insufficient positive cluster data. Rule remains INFO; no REVIEW threshold is calibrated.

negation_sequence.note: Small sample; REVIEW detector is provisional and metrics are descriptive, not strong evidence.

staccato_sequence.note: Small sample; REVIEW detector is provisional and intentionally allows false positives.

dialogue_pingpong.note: Only detector family with enough balanced evidence for a meaningful first descriptive hold-out check; still not a universal literary rule.

filter_terms.note: Too little matched control material for threshold calibration. Rule remains INFO.

semantic_explanation_echo.note: No mechanical detector in v0.1. Reserved for later manual/LLM gate review.
